question:
The following Venn diagram shows Men’s profession as Doctors and Chess Players.

How many men are doctors?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4cf8299f36011363bbc73603a91d83699089762e8ebbf4b3bad96cdc317144e.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0249e729559e23df4813b7d3550f3df134fab3caa24c184234e00ffabe4f92ff.png] 

The shaded region represents the total number of men who are doctors.

So, the total number of men who are doctors = (23 + 24) = 47

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
